purpose: Freeze a finite crop, livestock, aquaculture and plantation biological-production lifecycle before source rows, values, formulas, comparators, prices or returns.

repository_evidence.bounded_search_scope: Campaign source-frontier JSON files through Campaign190
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: A living cohort changes through planting or stocking, biological growth, mortality, maturation, harvest and replacement. Generic installed capacity, fixed-asset construction, commodity price, environmental externality, incident or mineral-reserve states do not reconstruct that cohort path.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A latest acreage, herd, biomass or harvest figure cannot be projected backward without cohort, biological-stage, scope, unit, restatement, correction and first-public histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: crop_plot_sowing_emergence_growth_maturity_harvest_yield_and_quality_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time plot or base history freezes planted and harvested area, crop and variety, sowing, emergence, maturity and harvest stages, yield and quality denominators, losses, scope revisions and first-public timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: livestock_breeding_herd_birth_growth_mortality_cull_slaughter_and_replacement_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete herd and cohort history preserves breeding stock, births, purchases, age and weight progression, mortality, culling, sales, slaughter, replacement and unit reconciliation with close-known availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: aquaculture_pond_stocking_biomass_survival_feed_conversion_harvest_and_restocking_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted pond, cage or site history connects stocking counts and biomass, species and batch, survival, feed conversion, growth, harvest, fallow and restocking with complete denominator and revision semantics.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: orchard_plantation_forestry_planting_immaturity_bearing_maturity_harvest_and_replanting_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time stand or block history freezes planted area, age class, immature-to-bearing transfer, expected productive life, harvest, damage, retirement and replanting across issuer and subsidiary boundaries.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: inventory_fair_value_commodity_price_weather_incident_environmental_capex_scale_or_mineral_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Accounting balances, market prices, weather observations, incidents, externalities, constructed assets, generic capacity and mineral reserves do not identify a living cohort and its biological conversion history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: species_breed_variety_region_season_stage_direction_threshold_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing species, varieties, regions, seasons, stages, directions, thresholds or windows before source admission multiplies hypotheses and selects around reporting survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_crop_livestock_aquaculture_and_plantation_biological_cycle_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining unadmitted components or choosing normalization, weights, interactions and models is closed before each base history passes the same source gate.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: immutable official agricultural registry, issuer filing, operating report or audited source identifiers and bytes
reference-period, observation, filing, exchange-publication, correction and first-public timestamps with trading-session availability
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, farm, base, plot, herd, pond, cage, stand and product mapping
point-in-time agricultural issuer scope and structural not-applicability without current-universe survivorship
crop, variety, species, breed, biological-asset class and production-system taxonomy
cohort, batch, plot, farm, geography and ownership or operating-right identity and continuity
sowing, stocking, birth, growth, immaturity, bearing, maturity, harvest, slaughter, retirement and replanting stage semantics
area, headcount, weight, biomass, volume, yield, quality, mortality, survival and feed-conversion units and denominators
opening, addition, transfer, loss, sale, harvest, slaughter, closing and reconciliation semantics for every cohort
disease, weather damage, abnormal mortality, culling, crop failure and resolution identity without relabeling Campaign166 incidents
scope change, acquisition, disposal, reclassification, restatement, correction, supersession, true-zero, missing and not-applicable semantics
complete 2019-2023 manifest, issuer-cohort history, mapping, coverage and chronology tests without factor, comparator, price or return values
